verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a live-session-to-voice-agent path. WebSocket media adapters stream call audio out as PCM to a server such as a Durable Object and accept PCM back into the SFU, and a documented example transcribes microphone audio with Workers AI and sends generated speech back to browsers. The middle language-model step is only implied, and the pack has no detailed walkthrough. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the LLM/reasoning step between STT and TTS, a step-by-step tutorial of the full pipeline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech

citations.quote: Transcribe microphone audio with Workers AI, then send generated speech to browsers through WebSocket media adapters.
Any server that accepts WebSockets, such as a Durable Object, can receive live call audio as PCM samples and video as JPEG frames without implementing a WebRTC client.
You can also send PCM audio into the SFU for WebRTC clients to hear.
